items.title: Nets’ Danny Wolf makes most of long-awaited opportunity with big performance
items.author: New York Post

items.title: The Brooklyn Nets have exercised the rookie scale team options for the 2027-28 season on Egor Dëmin ($7.58 million), Nolan Traore ($4.19 million), Drake Powell ($3.71 million), Ben Saraf ($3.17 million), and Danny Wolf ($3.08 million).
items.author: Michael Scotto
items.body_excerpt: The Brooklyn Nets have exercised the rookie scale team options for the 2027-28 season on Egor Dëmin ($7.58 million), Nolan Traore ($4.19 million), Drake Powell ($3.71 million), Ben Saraf ($3.17 million), and Danny Wolf ($3.08 million).
